mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install French doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing French doors varies widely based on several factors, including the type and material of the doors, their size, the complexity of the existing opening, and any necessary structural work. Custom doors, specialized glass, or extensive framing adjustments will increase the overall price. To get an accurate estimate from Hometelligent Inc., we recommend a site visit to assess your specific needs and the scope of work involved in your Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville home. This allows us to provide a transparent and detailed quote tailored to your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs for French doors depend on door type, size, existing opening complexity, and structural work. A site visit is recommended for an accurate quote.
